routes.name: Private embed (Desktop PBIP structure)
routes.description: Embed .pbiviz.json (with inline JS/CSS) in CustomVisuals/{GUID}/resources/ and declare CustomVisual resource package in report.json
routes.evidence: 3/3 fresh deployments via REST createItem, all render KPI value 600 on first view
limitations: Visual code bundled in every report (~8KB per visual)

routes.name: organizationCustomVisuals (org store)
routes.description: Register visual in admin portal org store, reference via organizationCustomVisuals in report.json
routes.evidence: Consent overlay blocks rendering; DOM inspection confirms visual code loads but consent prevents execution
routes.blocker: Per-viewer consent cannot be bypassed programmatically

routes.name: publicCustomVisuals (AppSource)
routes.description: Publish visual to AppSource marketplace, reference via publicCustomVisuals
routes.evidence: Not tested (visual not published to AppSource); 403 confirms Service attempts AppSource lookup
routes.one_time_setup: Partner Center account + AppSource visual publication (with or without certification)
limitations: Public visibility unless private plan used

routes.name: Embedded CustomVisual (separate JS/CSS/metadata)
routes.description: Store JS, CSS, metadata as separate items in CustomVisual resource package
routes.evidence: Deploys successfully but visual code never executes; blank container rendered
routes.blocker: Service only executes single-file .pbiviz.json format, not split resources

routes.name: RegisteredResources with .pbiviz
routes.blocker: RegisteredResources path not used for visual code loading

routes.name: Template priming (clone + updateDefinition)
routes.description: Clone pre-activated report then update definition
routes.evidence: updateDefinition resets consent state; consent reappears on cloned+updated reports
routes.blocker: Definition updates reset service-side consent state

zero_touch_evidence.method: REST createItem API with AAD token embedding
